from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReserveEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial reserve data from a single company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")
    item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial item as written in the document")
    amount_str: str | None = Field(description="The amount of the reserve item as it appears in the document")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit if explicitly stated")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed result for a single document."""
    reserve_entries: list[FinancialReserveEntry]
